observation_grid.reason: Fixed pre-result window selected to resolve the slowest nominal low-damping component scale in the declared grid without extending individual cases after results are viewed.

stability_and_spectral_metrics.spectral_displacement_from_uncoupled: minimum-sum bipartite matching of coupled poles to poles from kc=cc=0 with the same k1,k2,c1,c2, reported as RMS matched complex-plane displacement

isolated_component_coordinates.role: constituent isolated-component coordinates only; not a system chi

modal_scalar_admission.if_pass: diagonalize K by an orthonormal basis; verify transformed C off-diagonal Frobenius norm <= 1e-10; for each real decoupled mode report chi_mode=c_modal/(2*sqrt(k_modal))
modal_scalar_admission.complex_pole_pair_diagnostic: for each positive-imaginary conjugate pole lambda, report -Re(lambda)/|lambda| as COMPLEX_PAIR_DAMPING_RATIO; do not use this to pair real poles or define a master system chi

modal_participation.definition: for each reported right eigenvector, normalize the displacement block q and report |q_i|^2/sum_j|q_j|^2
modal_participation.interpretation: descriptive carrier participation only; not causal source fraction

energy_metrics.max_transient_gain: max_t E(t)/E(0) for each declared perturbation
energy_metrics.coupling_dissipation_fraction: integral cc*(v1-v2)^2 dt / E(0) over the fixed window

recovery_metrics.settling_time_2pct: first sampled time after which normalized_energy_state_norm remains <=0.02; null if not settled in fixed window
recovery_metrics.state_norm_integral: integral sqrt(E(t)/E(0)) dt over fixed window

claim_ceiling: Within-domain P0 mechanical Function/Limit mapping only. D01B is not untouched confirmation of general feedback/coupling claims and does not establish Chi prevalence.
